_comment: Sanitized CCR route template. No secret is present: api_key is substituted at runtime from the credentials env file by mtm-llm.sh. Derived from the validated host route (worklog/decisions/0004-in-image-llm-route.md): provider scaleway, type openai_chat_completions, model deepseek-v4.1-flash. The base URL comes from SCW_BASE_URL at runtime. The loopback gateway block is required: without it CCR rejects the client key with an authentication plugin error.
